idea.title: Rehearsed five times
idea.summary: Five kind, specific English-as-second-language moments, opening on rehearsing an order five times, built to send to the friend who does it.
hookOptions: I said 'you too' to the waiter
Thought of the perfect reply two hours later
You nod when you don't understand
Sorry for my English, then perfect English

scenes.say: You rehearse one sentence five times. The waiter leaves.

scenes.title: English learners you definitely know

items.title: The silent rehearser
items.line: Says it five times in their head. The waiter has left.

items.title: The 'same to you' one
items.line: Waiter says enjoy your meal. They say, you too!

items.title: The confident nodder
items.line: Understood nothing. Nodded with full confidence.

items.title: The accent apologiser
items.line: Says sorry for their English, then speaks it perfectly.

items.title: You, in the shower
items.line: Thinks of the perfect reply two hours late.

scenes.cta: send this to the nodder you know
scenes.say: Rehearsed five times. Same to you, waiter. Nodded, understood nothing. Sorry, then perfect. Perfect reply, two hours late.
Say it out loud, no waiter. randomtalker.com
